name: manual_77a6c0
claim: Before acting on a code-review finding, pull origin/main first so the reviewed commit is actually present in the local working tree.

decisions.notes: A review may reference a commit that merged to main after the local clone was last updated; applying the finding against stale files can produce wrong or conflicting edits. Today's sync of orama-system and Perpetua-Tools brought in several already-merged fixes that would have been reworked otherwise.
